verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only pieces of an offline fallback: a form search ('Rechercher un formulaire'), a contact and appointment page, a map of physical reception points, and one phone line limited to e-invoicing enquiries. Nothing shows a documented paper or mail filing route with exact postal addresses or fax numbers for use when the online service is down. Missing for 10: an explicit offline/paper filing procedure, exact mailing addresses or fax numbers per task, guidance on when paper filing is accepted, and independent corroboration that the fallback works.
